title: Kconfig: document CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE fail-open semantics
description: Child of worker6-l9hb decomposition (acceptance item 3). lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/Kconfig:81-93 LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE help must state: disabled = whole OSCORE branch compiles out, is_protected=false, every gate degrades to lichen_coap_is_local_admin (admin-only fallback; remote OSCORE peers get 4.01); enabled = OSCORE verify by EUI64 ctx lookup + admin fallback. Host-verifiable; no native_sim needed.
close_reason: LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE help now documents the mutating-request gate: enabled = OSCORE verify by EUI-64 ctx lookup + inner-method check (4.01 on missing ctx, 4.05 on method mismatch) with local-admin fallback for unprotected requests; disabled = whole OSCORE branch compiles out, gates degrade to admin-only (4.01 for remote mesh peers), explicitly not an open gate; only handlers routed through the helper inherit the properties. All claims fact-checked against coap_oscore.c:45-89, coap_keys.c:51-98, and handlers (coap_config.c:752, coap_waypoints.c:926/1069, checkin_resource.c:156). Kconfig parses clean (kconfiglib), git diff --check clean. 3x codereview (correctness/security/edge) done: 2 in-diff fixes applied (spec citation 8.7->15.6; em-dash convention); 3 verified findings filed: worker6-3yhv (P2 slot_coord conflict_cose_len compile break), worker6-zyvc (P3 Kconfig doc accuracy BLE/SLIP + client 8.7 citation), worker6-2clx (P3 gate-name staleness after 2z8e).
